data.title: Season 1  Departure with the Wind:Part 1 — Known Issues & Fixes
data.content:
Dear Pathfinders,

Here is a summary of the currently known game issues. Polaris Institute is actively working to resolve them. Please take note of the following:

1. In rare cases under poor network conditions, damage from Irisalis's Ultimate may fail to register, and its clones may not be created correctly.

2. On some mobile devices, Sparkling Prismana Aniimo may display different colors than on PC.

3. The Butterflies Among the Blossoms avatar frame does not unlock correctly.

4. In rare cases, attempting to catch an Alpha may trigger a status error message, preventing the capture process from starting.

5. The preview shown when claiming back accessories as Lightweave milestone rewards may display incorrectly. You will only receive the accessory corresponding to your character—either Dreamdrift Waltz or Golden Bough Dreamstrings. The actual rewards are unaffected.

6. Opening the Forest of Butterfly Dreams event page in indoor locations such as ChillBeanz may cause display issues. Pathfinders can leave the current area and try again.

7. The game may freeze on some Android devices during the Stars and the Knight Journey quest. Affected Pathfinders can try switching the graphics preset to Performance Mode or disabling Shadows in Settings. Alternatively, use the button in the upper-right corner of the screen to skip the cutscene.

8. In the Boundless Twining event, rewards may not be claimable when logging in on mobile immediately after logging in on PC. Affected Pathfinders can try logging in again to resolve the issue.

9. Unexpected blocks or outlines may appear when entering Home on mobile.

10. Pathfinders who have already redeemed the Forest of Butterfly Dreams outfit may not receive Lightweave Fragments as expected when obtaining the same outfit again using Lightweave Tickets.

11.Some mobile Pathfinders may encounter a gifting failure when trying to gift the Monthly Pass / Companion Handbook to friends, with the purchased content incorrectly granted to the account of the character currently in use.

【Price Adjustment Notice】

Due to recent platform pricing policy adjustments, prices for in-game purchases in Bolivia and all regions using the Bolivian Boliviano (BOB) will be adjusted accordingly in stages.

Please note that price updates in the in-game store may be delayed. Please refer to the actual price shown at checkout.

To provide a better experience, Polaris Institute will continue to improve the game and address any issues identified. The fixes included in this update are as follows:


Oct 17 Optimization & Fixes

>>Bug Fixes

1. Fixed an issue where Tiered Grand Gifts Stage 4 rewards could not be claimed normally.

2. Fixed an issue in Operation: Egg Heist where Collectible icons displayed abnormal flickering effects.


Oct 16 Optimization & Fixes

【Bug Fixes】

1. Fixed an issue with severe lag when opening the menu on console.

2. Fixed an issue in Operation: Egg Heist on console where Aniimo nicknames displayed offset.

【Optimizations & Adjustments】

1. The Companion Handbook will launch a limited-time EXP Boost event! While the Companion Handbook is below level 70, EXP gained will receive an additional multiplier boost.

[Start Time]

「Aniimo-Europe」2026/10/19 04:00 UTC+0

「Aniimo-Americas」2026/10/19 04:00 UTC-4

「Aniimo-Apac」2026/10/19 04:00 UTC+8


Oct 14 Optimization & Fixes

【Bug Fixes】

1. Fixed an issue where the "Tumbler" had an abnormal effect after use in certain situations.

2. Fixed an issue where, when Pathfinders used a face customization code, different races resulted in inconsistent face customization results.

3. Fixed an issue where a character's face was displayed incorrectly after Pathfinders triggered the outfit-change animation (the actual face customization data was not affected).

4. Fixed an issue where the Alpha AI in Holo-Battle Interlink Cycles 4 and 5 behaved abnormally. Update the game resources before entering this mode.


Oct 12 Optimization & Fixes

【Bug Fixes】

1. Fixed an issue on PS5 and Xbox where, after the game had been running for a while, persistent visual effects when using an Aniimo's Ultimate displayed abnormally, causing a black screen.

2. Fixed an issue on PS5 and Xbox where a black screen occurred when viewing Aniimo in Aniilog and persisted after returning to the game.

3. Fixed an issue on Xbox where long battles in "Holo-Battle Interlink" could cause abnormal memory usage and crashes.

【Optimizations & Adjustments】

1. Slightly reduced the number of extra Aniimo spawns caused by the in-match countdown and special reward events (digging up rare Eggs / Rare Collectibles) in Operation: Egg Heist on Nightmare and Chaos difficulties.

2. Lowered Umbral Erlath's HP and increased its drop rewards.


Oct 10 Optimization & Fixes

【Bug Fixes】

1. Fixed an issue in Companion Mode where friends did not receive reward mail when reporting.

2. Fixed an issue where the "Coilstrike Coupon" could not be issued normally when a one-time cumulative Voxel Coin spend exceeded 2,000.

3. Fixed an issue where the map icon for "Morphling's Trial" did not disappear after the activity was completed.

4. Fixed an issue where Harvest Moon Points were not being acquired correctly in Home.

5. Fixed an issue in "Dark Cave" where progress could get blocked at certain stages, preventing subsequent stages from starting normally.

6. Fixed an issue where players occasionally could not end conversations with the "Mysterious Vendor".

7. Fixed an issue where the actual amount of Wood Blocks obtained when clearing Home plots did not match the description.

8. Fixed an issue where "Moonray Wheat" displayed inconsistently in the Home shop.

9. Fixed an issue in Operation: Egg Heist where skill icons could disappear.

10. Fixed an issue where the Elite Training elective quest "Defeat 18 types of Aniimo Alphas/Omegas" could not be completed normally. Pathfinders can re-challenge the Alpha "Glynsera" after the version update for it to count correctly.

【Optimizations & Adjustments】

1. Optimized part of the Home controller tutorial flow.


Oct 9 Optimization & Fixes

【Bug Fixes】

1. Fixed an issue on mobile where switching the camera while moving caused movement to be too fast.

2. Fixed an issue where skill casting on mobile was affected when the BINI #9 prompt appeared.

3. Fixed an issue where some Aniimo skills were offset to the front-left, causing them to miss enemies after locking on.

4. Fixed an issue where some description text was incorrect in the "Collect Voxel Coins!" quest.

5. Fixed an issue where errors could occur when using another player's combo code.

6. Fixed an issue where some Aniimo sank into the ground.

7. Fixed an issue where some furniture in Home could disappear after being placed.

8. Fixed an issue where players could not select the Egg they wanted to hatch using the Hatchinator in Home.

9. Fixed an issue where pressing L3 then O in Aniilog, Events, Institute Guide, Settings, or Branch caused a black screen.

10. Fixed an issue where certain achievement types did not unlock after switching platforms.

11. Fixed an issue where obtaining different Prismatic Collectibles did not unlock the trophy.

12. Fixed an issue in extreme cases where the Morphling Stele on the map would not dissipate correctly after Pathfinders completed "Morphling's Trial".

13. Fixed an issue in Operation: Egg Heist where Chips were lost due to insufficient space when unequipping the backpack.

【Optimizations & Adjustments】

Added Erlath, an Aniimo with a group-support mechanic. Pathfinders are advised to defeat it first when encountered.


Sep 30 Optimization & Fixes

【Bug Fixes】

1. Fixed an issue with abnormal opponent behavior in Pathfinder Duel under poor network conditions.

2. Fixed a rare issue where Aniimo traits stopped working in Holo-Battle Interlink.

3. Fixed an issue with the duration of Waleetle's Vortex Assault effect.

4. Fixed a rare crash that could occur when saving Irisalis's accessory setup.

【Optimizations & Adjustments】

1. Team voice chat is now disabled by default to avoid unnecessary interruptions. To enable it, go to Sound Settings > Voice Settings.


Sep 28 Optimization & Fixes

【Bug Fixes】

1. Fixed an issue where some of Irisalis's model textures became blurry after using Transmog to switch to styles from the Starbloom Moonlight or Sunflare Rose sets.

2. Fixed an issue where some model textures on Grizbo, Luminelle, and Sherro became blurry.

3. Fixed an issue where attempts to catch Alphas sometimes failed with the message Cannot catch the Alpha in the current state.

4. Fixed an issue where joining a friend's party via Come to My World early in the game could block progression.

5. Fixed an issue where the shortcuts for viewing and gifting Aniimo conflicted.

6. Fixed an issue where incorrect text was displayed when Sparkling Pigment could not be used.

7. Fixed an issue where the button combination for exiting flight did not work.

8. Fixed an issue where Sparkling Aniimo could not be selected with a controller in Aniimo Management.

9. Fixed an issue where certain button inputs conflicted in Companion Mode.

10. Fixed an issue that caused stuttering when opening the Album on PlayStation.

11. Fixed an issue where the Safe and Sound and Friends in Focus achievements could not be unlocked.

12. Fixed a rare teleportation issue that caused scenes to load incorrectly. Pathfinders who encounter this issue can go to the Outpost and use the green interaction point to reload the correct scene.

13. Fixed an issue where the bridge in the construction area disappeared when visiting another Pathfinder's Home.

14. Fixed a rare issue where the Umbral Stellarys Alpha's immunity to control effects did not work correctly in Operation: Egg Heist.

【Optimizations & Adjustments】

1. Updated the item acquisition notification icon for Legendary Aniipod: Irisalis.

2. Updated the showcase video and image for Legendary Aniipod: Departure with the Wind to match its actual in-game effects.


Sep 27 Optimization & Fixes

【Optimizations & Adjustments】

Improved network connection stability when switching maps to reduce disconnection and reconnection issues.


Sep 26 Optimization & Fixes

【Bug Fixes】

1. Fixed an issue in Aniimo Transmog where the third preset could not be dragged when replacing a saved preset.

2. Fixed a display issue that occurred when closing the photo preview in the Tracing the Trail event.

3. Fixed an issue on mobile where the RV's silhouette did not appear in the level-up preview.

4. Fixed an issue on certain mobile devices where movement in egg form stuttered in Operation: Egg Heist.

5. Fixed a rare issue where the countdown in Operation: Egg Heist was inaccurate.

6. Fixed an issue where rewards from the Aniimo Discovery event could not be claimed under certain circumstances.

【Optimizations & Adjustments】

1. Optimized the button layout on the Aniimo Info screen on mobile.

2. Improved the control experience after pressing the left joystick on mobile.


Sep 24 Optimization & Fixes

【Bug Fixes】

1. Fixed an issue in Operation: Egg Heist where Pathfinders had a chance to be instantly killed when performing a Twine action with an Aniimo that has Pathfinding ability.

2. Fixed an issue in Operation: Egg Heist where some skill icons disappeared.

3. Fixed an issue where the entrance effect was abnormal when switching to an Aniimo equipped with Accessories.

4. Fixed an issue where the camera was abnormal when an Aniimo equipped with Accessories used its Ultimate.

5. Fixed an issue where Pawney could not use the Hookshot skill normally after equipping Accessories.

6. Fixed an issue where the collab Aniimo sparkelf could abnormally use Sparkling Pigments. sparkelf in Sparkling Form and Prismana Form only has an outline sparkle effect and does not support partial color change effects. For Pathfinders who previously used Sparkling Pigments, the relevant items will be returned via in-game mail.

7. Fixed an issue where PS5 could freeze or crash after prolonged play in ChillBeanz Cafe (Tea party).

8. Fixed an issue on Xbox where setting the Flying Aniimo to Prismana Fulmintis caused freezing or crashing.

【Optimizations & Adjustments】

1. Increased the spawn chance of Egg Nest in Operation: Egg Heist on Chaos difficulty.

2. Increased the drop rate of Prismatic Chests in Operation: Egg Heist on Hard and Nightmare difficulties.

3. Optimized stability on Xbox and PS5 to reduce abnormal exits (GC fix).


Sep 23 Optimization & Fixes

【Bug Fixes】

1. Fixed an issue where certain facilities in Home occupied an abnormal area.

2. Fixed an issue where Android users could not team up with console and Steam platforms.

3. Fixed an issue where the gameplay icon on the map did not disappear after completing the Rookey Glass gameplay in Russet Highlands.

4. Fixed an issue where, in multiplayer Companion Mode, some Pathfinders were blocked on the Family Reunion quest.

5. Fixed an issue on PC where triggering Prismana Aniimo caused the map to open automatically and resulted in freezing.

6. Fixed an issue where some furniture descriptions in Home were incorrect.

7. Fixed an issue where the animation would freeze when Pathfinders switched to another Aniimo to enter the field after Helion or Lunara equipped with Accessories used their Ultimate.

8. Fixed an issue where the reward claim area for certain events was abnormal.

9. Fixed an issue where the ground visual effects for Lunara's skill Moon Impact displayed abnormally in certain situations.

10. Fixed an issue where some Pathfinders were unable to interact with Pathfinding Instructor Dr. Lewis after an abnormal disconnection and re-login.

【Additional Information】

If a black screen occurs, please try the following:

1. Update the graphics driver.

2. Try switching between DX11 and DX12.

3. Disable DLSS and Frame Generation on the login screen.

——The Polaris Institute Team
